ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Eastern Asia in Western Art Music Takemitsu, Cage, Yun, Dun, and Beyond.” This course will explore elements of Western music in the work of East Asian composers such as Toru Takemitsu, Isang Yun, and Tan Dun. It will also explore elements of East Asian music in the work of Western composers like John Cage and John Zorn. Through a combination of historical, social, and political analysis, this course will explore intercultural synthesis in post-1945 music.
